summary: Tested the fix for the 'Valutazioni usato' barca 0 € bug. The backend was run against the live AI 3 times and passed every time. Barca (Jeanneau Cap Camarat 755 2008 usurato + 2x Suzuki DF140 2008 1700h): motore 6000-8500/7200, gommone 17000-24000/20000, totale 23000-32500/27200, and totale = motore + gommone. Gommone (GEB 780 Tsunami 2016 buono, tubolari rifatti 2 anni, 1 motore): all values > 0 and consistent. The PDF returns 200 application/pdf. The pypdf text contains 'Imbarcazione – Barca' and 'N° motori', has no '0 € – 0 €', and the gommone PDF shows 'Rifatti da 2 anni'. Validation returns 400 for an empty body and for an invalid stato, and 404 for an unknown id. Unit tests of _normalizza cover the imbarcazione/barca aliases, deriving the gommone value from totale − motore, and deriving totale. Frontend smoke check: val-motore-numero and val-gommone-tipo are present, 7 cards are listed, and every val-quota-gommone-* (BARCA/GOMMONE) shows a non-zero amount.

minor.issue: float() on AI values crashes when the AI returns strings like '6.000 €'. The exception is caught, so the valutazione is saved with stato 'errore' instead of being parsed. A '12.000' string is read as 12.0. A safe numeric parser (remove everything that is not a digit) would make this more robust.

Values are only derived when ALL 3 values of a mezzo are 0. Partial zeros (e.g. valore_consigliato 0 while min/max > 0) are not fixed. A gommone-only or motore-only valutazione with all zeros has no fallback (it is not retried).

issues: Thousands separators are inconsistent: 4-digit amounts show as '2600 € – 3400 €' while 5-digit ones show as '26.000 €'. it-IT Intl does not group 4-digit numbers by default; use useGrouping 'always' or a manual formatter.

action_items: Optional: make the AI value parsing robust to string amounts in _normalizza
Optional: fix the inconsistent thousands formatting for 4-digit amounts in ValutazioneCard
critical_code_review_comments: _normalizza: use a helper like num(v) that strips non-digits, so one malformed AI value does not turn the whole valutazione into 'errore'
For single-mezzo valutazioni, consider re-asking the AI if all values are 0
seed_data_creation: TEST_barca / TEST_gommone valutazioni were created and deleted in teardown
context_for_next_testing_agent: The valutazioni tests call the real AI (about 20s each). Run them with -n0 -s to see the values. The PDF text from pypdf puts labels and values in separate columns.
